capabilities: Search emojis by text filter or fuzzy/semantic match
Insert emojis via command or hotkey into the editor
Insert emojis into titles, file renames and context menus
Pick skin tone variants and reuse recently used emojis
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README mixes English and Chinese (the command name is given in Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search for and insert emojis across editors, file titles, rename dialogs and mobile.

relations.evidence: a big thanks to liamcain for producing the obsidian-react-starter which the basis of v0.3.0+ is made from

summary: Emoji insertion tool that lets you fuzzy-search and insert emojis into editors, titles, rename fields, context menus and on mobile.
